front: What is a time series foundation model?
back: A large model pre-trained on many varied series. It forecasts new series zero-shot from the recent context.
The model forecasts your series without any training on your data.

front: What are context length and prediction length?
back: Context length: how many past values it reads. Prediction length: how many future steps one call returns.

front: Three tests before using a foundation model?
back: Backtest on your data vs seasonal naive and tuned simple models; check pre-training leakage; compare cost and latency.
New weights can change all forecasts. Pinning makes results reproducible and auditable.
